visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a wide landscape of snow-capped mountains and a blue fjord. A couple stands on a rocky hill in the foreground, with the woman wearing a vibrant pink hooded jacket. The scene cuts rapidly to the woman holding a grey drone controller in a forest, and then to a group of people jumping off a white tour boat into deep blue ocean water. A close-up of a black DJI Osmo Action 5 Pro camera is shown on a grey textured surface. (2) The woman in the pink jacket walks across a metal platform overlooking a steep mountain pass with a winding road below. She is then seen in a sunlit outdoor area with ancient-looking stone pillars (likely Egypt), taking a selfie. High-speed boat footage follows, showing water splashing against the lens. The woman is then submerged underwater, holding the camera to film divers and coral. (3) A DJI Air 3S drone is shown hovering in a forest with tall green pine trees. A man's hands hold a large controller with a built-in screen showing a lake view. Cinematic aerial shots transition between a calm lake at sunset, a snowy valley with red houses and white camper vans, and the woman running through a dense forest. Digital UI markers (green boxes) appear on screen, highlighting the tracking feature. (4) The woman stands in a park near a large tree, gesturing towards the scenery. She is shown in multiple settings—by a lake, in the woods, and finally back on the snowy mountain outcrop with her male companion. The lighting shifts from bright daylight to the warm, golden tones of sunset, ending with the mountain landscape under a clear blue sky.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy female narrator speaking in Traditional Chinese with a bright, enthusiastic tone. A fast-paced electronic beat with a strong kick drum starts immediately. A distinct 'splash' SFX is heard as the visual shows people jumping into water. (2) The narration becomes denser as the speaker lists camera specifications. The BGM remains consistent in tempo. Short, sharp 'whoosh' sound effects are used to punctuate rapid visual scene transitions. Bubbling water sounds are added during the underwater footage. (3) The audio texture shifts slightly as a low-frequency mechanical hum (simulating a drone) is introduced. High-pitched 'beeps' and digital UI clicks occur in sync with the appearance of tracking markers on the screen. The narrator's pitch rises during the description of 'night vision' features. (4) The music builds to a rhythmic crescendo. The narrator delivers a final energetic call to action with high vocal arousal. The track ends with a clean fade-out of the music and voice.
